name: Chande Kroll Stop
notes: Uses the canonical lowest-low short stop; the bundled legacy script uses lowest-high instead.

name: Detrended Price Oscillator
notes: Causal uncentered mode: source minus the moving average delayed by floor(length/2)+1 bars.

name: Historical Volatility
notes: Annualization is an explicit bars-per-year factor; it is not inferred from chart resolution.

name: Ichimoku Cloud
notes: Cloud spans shifted forward within supplied timestamps. Lagging values are current closes with a visual offset of -25 bars.

name: Moving Average Channel
notes: Unshifted high/low averages; legacy visual offsets are not exposed.

name: Volatility Index
notes: Wilder ATR trailing stop; seeded after length bars. Repeated closes still advance bar state.

name: VWAP
notes: Anchors use UTC calendar boundaries; exchange-session calendars are not inferred.

name: Williams Fractal
notes: Fractals are reported at confirmation time, not backdated to the pivot.

name: Zig Zag
notes: Close-based percentage reversals; confirmed extremes reported at confirmation time without repainting.

name: Pivot Points Standard
notes: Traditional pivot levels use the previous complete UTC day/week/month.

name: Volume Profile Visible Range
notes: OHLCV approximation: uniform volume allocation across each bar high-low range.

name: Volume Profile Fixed Range
notes: OHLCV approximation over the last bars parameter; uniform volume allocation across each high-low range.

name: Smart Money Concepts
notes: SMC geometry uses only the supplied closed-bar snapshot (maximum 5000 bars).
Swing origins are backdated geometry; confirmedAt records confirmation and provisional marks the mutable terminal pivot. Recompute on each replay prefix; drawings are not historical trading signals.
